Accounts Executive
The Account Executive is responsible for handling daily accounting operations, maintaining financial records, and supporting financial reporting and compliance activities.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation.
•	Prepare invoices, vouchers, and payment schedules.
•	Assist in monthly and annual financial reporting.
•	Coordinate with auditors and internal teams.
Requirements:
•	Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related fields.
•	1-3 years of experience in accounting or finance.

Human Resource Manager
The human resource manager is responsible for overseeing all HR functions including recruitment, employee relations, performance management and compliance with labor regulations. 
Key Responsibilities:
•	Manage end-to-end recruitment and onboarding processes.
•	 Develop and implement HR policies and procedures.
•	Handle employee relations and performance management.
•	Ensure compliance with labor laws and company regulations.
Requirements:
•	Bachelor's degree with 3-5 years' experience in HR operations or related.
•	3-5 years of experience in HR operations.
•	Strong communication and leadership skills.

Marketing Assistant/Manager
The marketing Assistant Manager supports the planning and execution of marketing campaigns, assists in brand development, and analyzes market trends to improve business growth. 
Key Responsibilities:
•	Assist in developing and executing marketing strategies.
•	Coordinate digital and offline marketing campaigns.
•	Analyze campaign performance and prepare reports.
•	Support campaign creation and social media reports.
Requirements:
•	Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or related field.
•	2-4 years of experience in marketing.
•	Knowledge of digital marketing tools and analytics.
